description:
Mortgage Broker Assistant

Velocity Experience Preferred | 30 Hours/Week | Remote



We are looking for an experienced, highly organized Mortgage Broker Assistant who can assist the Canadian Broker through the Closing & Funding stages of the loan. This is a mortgage operations role focused on helping move files efficiently through the closing and funding process. You will support the brokerage with document packages, compliance, file management, and mortgage administration.



This is not a client-facing role. We are specifically looking for someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable working behind the scenes, and experienced with mortgage files, documentation, and administrative processes.



Key Responsibilities



-Prepare, review, and organize mortgage document packages

-Support mortgage files through the closing and funding stages

-Review files to ensure required documents are complete and properly organized

-Assist with mortgage compliance documentation and file preparation

-Upload, organize, and maintain documents within the brokerage's systems

-Track outstanding documents and missing information

-Follow up internally on incomplete or outstanding file requirements

-Maintain accurate, complete, and organized mortgage files

-Ensure documentation is properly recorded and stored

-Support brokers and the internal team with mortgage-related administrative tasks

-Help keep mortgage files progressing efficiently toward closing and funding

-Complete additional mortgage administration responsibilities as assigned



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone with direct mortgage industry experience who understands the importance of accuracy, documentation, compliance, and deadlines. Strong candidates will have experience working with mortgage brokers, brokerages, lenders, underwriting teams, fulfillment teams, or mortgage administration departments.



Required Skills & Experience



-Previous experience working in the mortgage industry

-Strong administrative and organizational skills

-Ability to manage multiple mortgage files and priorities simultaneously

-Ability to identify missing or incomplete documentation

-Comfortable following detailed processes and compliance requirements

-Strong written English communication skills

-Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

-Fast learner who can quickly adapt to new systems and workflows

Strongly Preferred



-Experience with Canadian mortgages

Schedule

title: Ad Designer for US Creative Agency (Statics + GIFs for DTC Brands)
description:
The post

Most ad designers make it pretty. We need it to stop the scroll and read in one second.



We're a US creative strategy studio making paid social ads (Meta, TikTok) for premium DTC brands in home, beauty and fashion. Our strategists find the reason to buy. You make it look like the brand's own design team made it, and readable on a phone before someone scrolls past.



What you'd do

Design statics and GIFs for our weekly ad batches. One batch = one idea in 3 variations.

Work in two lanes, and know which one you're in:

Hi-fi: looks like the brand's in-house team made it. Their fonts, their logo at the right proportions, their colours, lots of space. No drop shadows, no heavy outlines.

Lo-fi on purpose: looks like a real person posted it. Native TikTok and IG text, a trending font or emoji where it fits. Authentic but tidied up, never cheap by a
.

Finishing pass on text, pills, logos and proof lines on our edited videos.

Check every ad at real phone size before it leaves your hands.

Speed, please read this part properly

A batch goes from brief to ready in 24 hours max.

Revisions come back within a few hours.

You're online during US Eastern hours, or close to it. That's evening into night in Manila. Feedback shouldn't wait overnight.

If that pace or those hours don't work for your life, this isn't the role, and we'd rather you knew now.



What you need to already have

Experience designing ads for DTC / ecommerce brands. A portfolio of paid social ads, not logos or brand identities.

Real typography skills: hierarchy, spacing, minimum text sizes, how text reads on mobile.

Figma for statics, and After Effects or CapCut for GIFs and light motion.

You work inside a brand system without improvising: fonts, weights, logo rules, colour guides.

Clear written English.

AI is welcome. Use whatever tools make you faster, as long as the final ad looks designed by someone who cares.

Bonus: you draw or illustrate by hand. Hand-drawn arrows, doodles and lettering make lo-fi ads feel real.



What we pay

$25 to $30 USD per batch (3 ads, statics + GIF), depending on experience. Paid per approved batch, by Wise. We work across several brands, so there's steady volume every week, and more as we grow.



How we hire

Shortlisted designers get one short test: redesign one ad in both lanes, hi-fi and lo-fi. It's unpaid and small on purpose. If it's good, you're hired straight away and your first batch is paid.



Who this role is not for

Your portfolio is mostly logos, brand identities or social posts, not ads

You reach for a drop shadow to make text readable

24 hours from brief to ready sounds too tight

You can't be online during US hours

How to apply

Subject line: AD DESIGNER + your name. Applications with a different subject or missing any answer won't be read.



Link 3 to 5 paid social ads you designed for DTC brands. Which one are you proudest of, and why?

Send one ad you made that you'd redo today, and tell us what you'd change.

What's the smallest text size you'd use on a 1080 x 1350 static, and why?

Can you deliver a batch within 24 hours and revisions within a few hours, during US Eastern hours? Yes or no.

Which tools do you use for statics and GIFs, and which AI tools are part of your process?

Do you draw or illustrate by hand? If yes, show us.

title: IT Systems Administrator (Remote)
description:
About Techvestor

Techvestor is a US-based holding company with businesses in short-term rentals, property management, construction and renovation, and design. We run four business units and we are doubling headcount this year.





Why this role exists

We have never had a dedicated IT function. Today it is split between a Finance Lead, a People Lead who is moving to a full-time talent role, and an engineering lead. None of them should be doing it.





Concretely, this is what happens now:

- Someone forgets a password on a Saturday and calls our engineering lead directly

- An offboarding request arrives while that person is driving, so a leaver keeps their access until someone is free to revoke it

- When our virtual phone system goes down, the engineering lead calls the account manager, raises the ticket and chases the fix

- There is no record of what any individual has access to, across roughly 21 integrations, 29 running services, 12 domains and 8 databases

- Nobody audits what we are paying for or who is actually using it



You are hiring into a blank page. The first thing you build is the system that should already exist.



We are hiring two

One person cannot cover four business units across business hours and carry a rota. Two gives us a staffed desk and a sustainable alternating on-call. You will be hired as a pair, you will split brand coverage between you, and you will cover for each other.



What you will do

** Build the foundation — first 90 days

- Build the access register. Every person, every system, every permission level. This does not exist today and everything else depends on it.

- Write the joiner-mover-leaver runbook. What gets provisioned on day one by role, what changes on a move, and what gets revoked on exit — verified against the register, not from memory.

- Scope and stand up ticketing. We are building our own. You define the requirements, the priorities, the response targets and the categories; our engineers build it with you. Requests stop arriving as direct messages.

- Scope the request and approvals tool. Access requests, tool provisioning and license approvals routed to the right approver and logged against the person.



** Run it — ongoing

- First-line support across every business unit. Accounts, access, devices, software, the lot.

- Identity and access management. Google Workspace, Slack, 1Password, Atlassian, GitHub, Supabase, Render, Cloudflare, plus every operational platform — Hospitable, Breezeway, Turno, Quo, CompanyCam.

- Vendor management and escalation. When a platform breaks, you are the one who raises the ticket, chases the account manager, and keeps the business informed. Not an engineer.

- Subscription audit. A recurring review of every paid tool across the group: what we pay for, who actually uses it, what gets cancelled. This has never been done.

- Device fleet. Laptops and accounts for a doubling headcount, on-call phones, and field devices for market managers working across states.

- Security hygiene. MFA coverage, password policy, shared-credential elimination, and finding the vendors that still only offer SMS two-factor.

- 24/7 and weekend cover, alternating between the two of you.

- Documentation. Runbooks for everything, so the second person can cover the first.



** What you bring

- 3+ years in IT support, systems administration or IT operations, ideally in a company that was growing fast and under-tooled

- Google Workspace administration at admin level — users, groups, org units, security settings, device management

- Identity and access management. SSO, MFA, provisioning and deprovisioning, least-privilege. 1Password or a comparable enterprise password manager

- SaaS administration across a wide estate. Slack, Atlassian (Jira and Confluence), GitHub. Comfort learning a platform you have never seen because the business just bought it

- Ticketing systems. You have run a queue with published response targets and reported on it

- Vendor escalation. You have held a vendor to an SLA and chased an outage to resolution

- Asset and license management. You know what the company owns, who has it, and what it costs

- Clear written communication. Async-first, distributed, and you will be writing the documentation that does not exist yet

- Comfort with ambiguity. There is no runbook here. You are writing it



** Nice to have

- Scripting — Google Apps Script, Python or PowerShell — to automate provisioning rather than doing it by hand

- Experience selecting or specifying a ticketing system, not just using one

- Exposure to developer tooling: GitHub, Render, Supabase, Cloudflare

- Mobile device management, Apple device management

- Security or compliance work — access reviews, audit evidence

- Multi-entity or holding-company environments

- Experience as the first IT hire somewhere



** Where this role stops

- You own access, identity, devices, vendors and licenses. You do not build product features or own application code.

- You scope and specify the ticketing and request tools; engineers build them. You define the requirements, the priorities, the response targets and the categories. They write the code.

- You own SaaS and license spend. Hosting belongs to engineering, AI token spend belongs to the AI and Automation Specialist.

- You are the first responder for access, devices, accounts and third-party outages. Application failures, broken integrations and failed automations go to engineering — your job is to route them there fast, not to fix them.



** What success looks like

30 days - The access register exists and is complete for at least two business units. Both of you know every system we run.

60 days - Ticketing is live with published response targets. Requests stop going to engineers as direct messages.

90 days - Joiner-mover-leaver runbook in use. Every leaver verified against the register. First subscription audit delivered.

6 months - 24/7 and weekend cover running sustainably between you. Time-to-revoke on a leaver is a number we measure. No engineer has been pulled into an IT issue in a month.



** What we are not asking for

You are not a help desk ticket-closer. You are standing up a function, choosing the tooling, and writing the process. If you want to be handed a runbook, this is the wrong role. If you want to write the one that was never written, it is a good one.

title: Phone Sales + Dispatch VA – Miami Cleaning Company
description:
HOURS: Monday to Friday, 9 AM – 6 PM US Eastern (9 PM – 6 AM Philippine time; 10 PM – 7 AM from Nov 1).



PAY: $700/month, raise after a 60-day review. Paid monthly through OnlineJobs.ph Easypay. Long-term, full-time.



ABOUT US

We're two 19-year-old college students running Vassal Cleaning, a house cleaning company in Miami and South Florida. We book cleans for nice homes and send independent cleaners to do them. Small team, no corporate stuff, you work directly with the owners.



THE JOB

This is a phone sales job first. Leads come in from Thumbtack, Google and our website, and you turn them into booked cleans.

- Text every new lead back in under 1 minute, then call them

- Quote from our price list, handle "that's more than I expected," and close the booking

- Follow up with everyone who didn't book until they do or say no

- Dispatch: match each booked clean with a cleaner, confirm them the day before and the morning of, and find a replacement fast when someone cancels

- Handle customer texts and calls: reschedules, add-ons, complaints



Our prices and offers change a lot. We're always testing new deals, new areas and new add-ons. You need to roll with that and still sound confident on the next call.



WHO WE WANT

- You've sold over the phone and you liked it: home services, solar, real estate, dealership BDC, appointment setting, anything with a close

- You stay calm when three things happen at once

- You're chill and easy to talk to, and you lock in when it counts

- Near-native English with a neutral, American-sounding accent. Our customers are in Miami and should feel like they called someone local. This is the #1 requirement, and we judge it from your voice message

- At your computer the whole shift, with reliable internet plus a backup, a quiet spot and a headset



BIG PLUS

- Thumbtack, Angi, Yelp or Google Local Services leads

- Dispatch or scheduling for a cleaning, HVAC, plumbing or other home-service company

- Booking Koala, Quo/OpenPhone, Jobber, ZenMaid or any CRM

- Some Spanish (a lot of our cleaners speak Spanish)



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application ourselves. If it reads like ChatGPT wrote it, we skip it, no matter how good it sounds. Write like you'd text a friend. Typos are fine. No voice message = we don't read the rest.



1. Subject line: "Vassal Sales – [your name]"

2. A 60–90 second voice message (Vocaroo, Google Drive or Loom). Answer the phone like it's a real lead: they want a price for a 3-bedroom deep clean, you give one (make it up), and they say "hmm, that's more than I expected." Show us what you say next.

3. In 2–3 sentences: the best sale you ever closed. What were you selling, and what made them say yes?

4. In 1–2 sentences: a cleaner texts you at 7 AM that she can't make her 9 AM job. What do you do first?

5. Who is TJR? One sentence, no Googling. Wrong answers are fine.

6. Confirm you can work 9 AM – 6 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday.

7. If you have a Versant English score, include it (we're looking for 70+). No score is fine, the voice message counts most.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test.

title: Junior Paid Media Strategist (Google + Meta) – Luxury
description:

You'll work directly with our senior PPC strategists across a portfolio of Google Ads and Meta accounts, split between eCommerce stores measured on ROAS and local retailers measured on leads and appointments. You'll be running the daily and weekly optimization routine, building campaigns from an approved brief without hand-holding, and contributing to monthly client reports that a store owner can read and trust.

Run daily account checks across Google Ads and Meta: spend pacing, disapprovals, broken tracking, performance swings, and anything a client would notice before we do

Build and launch campaigns from a brief, including Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Meta prospecting, retargeting, and catalog ads

Execute optimizations (bids, budgets, negatives, audiences, creative rotations) and log every change in our shared optimization notes

Pull and QA performance data from Google Ads, Meta, GA4, and Shopify, and flag mismatches between platform-reported and actual revenue

Draft the data sections of monthly client reports in Looker Studio and Canva for senior review

Write and QA ad copy that follows each client's brand guidelines, including strict manufacturer rules for luxury watch brands



What we're looking for

2 years of hands-on experience in Google Ads and Meta Ads (both platforms; experience in only one is not enough for this role)

Has personally built and managed at least one live eCommerce or lead-gen campaign, not only assisted on a team

Working knowledge of GA4 and conversion tracking basics (what a conversion event is, how to tell when it's broken)

Comfortable in spreadsheets: pivoting exports, checking numbers, spotting what's off

Clear written English; you'll be writing ad copy and notes a US client will read

VERY IMPORTANT: Available during US Eastern business hours

Applying as an individual, not through an agency or on behalf of a team



Nice to have

Google Ads or Meta Blueprint certifications

Exposure to Shopify, Looker Studio, or GTM

Any experience with premium, luxury, or high-ticket products, or an instinct for why discount-driven messaging is wrong for a fine jewelry client

Familiarity with AI tools in your daily workflow



What you'll get

Direct mentorship from senior strategists who review your work and explain the why

Real ownership of accounts as you prove you can hold them

A niche (luxury retail paid media) that is hard to break into and valuable once you have it



To apply

Send CV and tell us one campaign you personally built and managed: the platform, the goal, the monthly budget, what you changed over its life, and the result. Feel free to include a report you've done (omitting client name).

title: Freelance Bookkeeper, Xero (UK clients), 10 hours/week, long-term
description:
We're a UK family-owned group of property and trading companies (about 18 companies) moving all our books onto Xero this month. You'll report to the group's director and work alongside our UK chartered accountants, who review the books monthly.

Post sales invoices, supplier bills and receipts.

Record and match intercompany charges between group companies every month, to the penny.

Keep directors' loan accounts accurate, and flag anything unusual before posting.

Property bookkeeping: rent received, deposits, service charges, and splitting mortgage payments into interest and capital.

Close each month by working day 10, with a short pack per company: P&L, balance sheet, cash and intercompany balances.

Prepare records for quarterly UK VAT returns (our accountants submit them).



Must have



Bachelor's degree in Accountancy.

Xero Advisor certification (include your certificate link).

3+ years' bookkeeping for UK clients, including UK VAT and Making Tax Digital.

Experience running several companies at once, including intercompany balances.

Strong written English; organised; works independently and asks good questions.

Available in three or four blocks a week, with some overlap with UK morning hours.



Nice to have



AAT, or part-qualified or qualified ACCA or CPA.

UK Construction Industry Scheme (CIS) experience.

Multi-currency experience (USD, EUR).

UK property bookkeeping.



Terms



Freelance, 10 hours a week, long-term. Hours reviewed after three months.

£5–6 per hour depending on experience, paid monthly in PHP equivalent.

Start: as soon as possible in October 2026.

Shortlisted applicants complete a paid 2-hour practical test in Xero, then a short video call.

You'll have your own Xero login. No bank passwords, and you won't make payments.

.

Pay

How to apply

This is a long-term position with real responsibility and room to grow. We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the company and stay with us long-term.



Thanks so much for your time. I really appreciate it.



Shimi

Why Join Us:

- Short-form videos for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok

This is a full-time position, not a per-video contract. Assignments will vary based on our current priorities and will be managed within a reasonable 40-hour workweek.



The Type of Editor We Need



We are not looking for someone who only removes mistakes, adds captions and uses transitions.



We need an editor who can understand the story, audience and purpose of a video. You should be able to take raw footage, scripts and supporting materials and turn them into compelling content without needing instructions for every edit.



You should know how to:



- Build a strong opening that captures attention

- Improve pacing and remove unnecessary sections

- Maintain viewer interest throughout a long-form video

- Use relevant B-roll to support what is being said

- Incorporate maps, community footage, screenshots and photographs

- Use clean text, graphics, music and sound design

- Preserve the personality of the person on camera

- Recognize strong moments that can become short-form videos

- Make each Short feel like a complete piece of content

- Create polished videos without overediting them



We want storytelling and intentional editing—not random effects, excessive captions or constant motion with no purpose.



Content You May Edit



- Dallas–Fort Worth relocation videos

- City and suburb comparisons

- Informational and educational videos

- Real estate market updates

- Neighborhood and community tours

- New-construction home tours

- Client success stories and case studies

- Just-listed and just-sold videos

- Behind-the-scenes content

- Personal-brand and personality-driven content

- YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok videos



Responsibilities



- Edit polished long-form YouTube videos

- Edit engaging vertical short-form videos

- Select the strongest takes from raw footage

- Improve hooks, pacing and overall viewer retention

- Find relevant and accurate B-roll when it is not provided

- Use maps, photographs, community footage and supporting visuals

- Add clean captions and on-screen text

- Perform audio cleanup, sound mixing and basic color correction

- Select properly licensed music and stock assets

- Follow our brand and editing standards

- Organize footage, assets and project files

- Complete revisions accurately and promptly

- Communicate progress, questions and delays proactively

- Deliver final exports and organized, editable project files

- Help improve our editing style as the channel grows



Required Qualifications



- Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos

- Strong short-form vertical editing experience

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Excellent comprehension of conversational American English

- Strong storytelling and pacing instincts

- Understanding of YouTube viewer retention

- Ability to select accurate and relevant B-roll

- Strong attention to spelling, names, locations and details

- Ability to work independently

- Ability to accept feedback without becoming defensive

- Reliable communication and deadline management

- Reliable computer, internet connection and file-backup process



Experience editing real estate, relocation, lifestyle, educational or documentary-style content is helpful but not required.



If your experience consists primarily of gaming montages, wedding videos, music videos, podcast clips or basic captioned Reels, this may not be the right position for you.



Software and Technical Requirements



Adobe Premiere Pro is preferred. DaVinci Resolve may also be considered.



Experience with After Effects, motion graphics, Photoshop or similar programs is a plus.



All music, stock footage, templates and other assets must be properly licensed for commercial use.



You must be willing to provide the editable project files associated with our work.



Availability



This position should be your primary professional commitment.



Limited outside freelance work may be acceptable if it does not interfere with your availability, communication, quality or deadlines. You must disclose your current employment and recurring clients during the application process.



You must also be available for occasional video meetings and maintain at least two hours of weekday overlap with U.S. Central Time.



Compensation



The salary range is $1,000–$1,500 USD per month. The final offer will depend on demonstrated skill, experience, communication and paid-trial performance.



We are looking for a long-term team member. There will be opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation as the role and business grow.



Selection Process



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete:



1. An application and portfolio review

2. A video interview conducted in English

3. A paid editing trial

4. One revision round based on feedback

5. A final interview



We do not request full unpaid sample edits.



How to Apply



Start the subject line of your application with:



STORY FIRST



Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.



Please provide the following:



1. A brief introduction about yourself

2. Your requested monthly salary

3. Your available start date

4. Your editing software

5. Your computer specifications and internet speed

6. Details about your current job, regular clients or freelance commitments

7. A link to the single best long-form YouTube video you personally edited

8. A link to the single best vertical short-form video you personally edited

9. A link to your portfolio, if you have one

10. A 60–90 second video introducing yourself and your experience in English



For each video sample, explain:



- Which portions you personally edited

- Whether you selected the B-roll

- Whether you created the graphics

- Whether you handled the audio and sound design

- Whether you completed the project independently or worked with a team



After reviewing our YouTube channel, answer these two questions:



1. What are the two most important editing improvements you would recommend for our channel, and why?

2. What would you do differently when editing one of our informational videos versus one of our home tours?



Please do not send a generic application, a large folder of unrelated work or videos that you did not personally edit.



We want someone who cares about storytelling, takes ownership of their work and wants to help us build one of the strongest real estate media brands in the Dallas–Fort Worth market.

title: Customer Service Manager | Women's Fashion Brand | $1,300-$1,700/mo + Bonus
description:
WHO WE ARE



We're a fast-growing womens clothing brand selling on Shopify.



Customer service is where we need real ownership this Q4 season. We need an experienced Customer Service Manager with native English fluency that has managed customer service teams before.



This is a big role. The person we hire will work closely with the owner and be accountable end-to-end for the entire back end customer service experience.



WHAT'S THE ROLE?



This is not a role for someone who sends macros and answers tickets.



You'll run customer service day to day: managing human and AI agents, keeping response times and quality on target, and improving the systems the team works from. We want a logical, detail-oriented thinker who looks at a messy workflow and wants to fix it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO?



• Manage our frontline agent, plus anyone we add as we grow. Review their work and get new agents up to speed.

• Know our policies inside out (returns, exchanges, store credit, delivery) and make sure they're applied consistently.

• Own our Gorgias setup: macros, tags, views, rules and automations.

• Write and maintain SOPs for the team.

• Run regular ticket QA and turn recurring mistakes into training or macro updates.

• Handle escalations from the team. When a macro doesn't fit, you use your own judgement within our policies to resolve it.

• Work with our fulfilment partner on delays, lost parcels and damaged orders, and keep customers updated.

• Spot what's driving repeat tickets, like sizing, quality or delivery issues, and flag it to us.

• Report weekly on how the department's doing and what you've changed.



WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY?



• 2+ years using Gorgias or Zendesk. You've configured it, not just answered tickets in it.

• Customer service experience at another large DTC brand.

• Experience hiring and training at least one human agent.

• Comfortable with Shopify order management.

• Strong written and spoken English, native or near-native.

• Good with data. You can pull a report, spot the trend and act on it.

• Calm under pressure. Angry customers, agent mistakes and supplier delays don't rattle you.

• You are a confident person who will speak up to raise a problem, not keep quiet and shy away hoping it will disappear.



NICE TO HAVE:



• Fashion or apparel e-commerce, especially sizing, exchanges and returns

• Experience with dropshipping or a third-party fulfilment partner

• Gorgias AI Agent or other helpdesk automation.



WHAT WE OFFER?



• $1300-$1700 +Quarterly KPI bonus worth about 10–15% of annual base.

• Starting probation period with a pay increase if successful.

• Full Time Work with progression opportunity.

• Real ownership and Decision making: You'll run the department, and we give you the power to make decisions on how it runs seamlessly.

• Fully remote, with a set overlap window and flexibility outside it.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs. Start your message with "Pomegranate", then answer these in your own words (no AI, please):



1) Basics: your timezone, hours you can overlap with UK, London Timezone. Salary expectation, and earliest start date.



2) Your build: one thing you've built in Gorgias or Zendesk (a rule, macro, view, tags or automation), the problem it solved, and what changed.



3) Your numbers: one support metric you improved, with the before and after.



4) Customer reply: our refund policy is 30 days from delivery for unworn items. A customer writes: "I bought these trousers 45 days ago and wore them twice. The waistband has stretched and they don't fit anymore. I want a full refund." Write your reply as you'd send it (under 150 words).



5) Gorgias certificate: link or attach any Gorgias Academy certificate (free at 
). This is required if your experience is Zendesk only.



Attach your CV. Applications that skip the first word or any question won't be reviewed.

title: Customer Service & Appointment Coordinator - Remote
description:
Customer Service & Appointment Coordinator– Remote

Full-time | Long-term

US hours (Mountain standard Time)



Customer Service & Appointment Coordinator

title: # Hiring Expert Funnel & Landing Page Designer / Developer – High-Converting Pages (Long-Term)
description:
# Hiring Expert Funnel & Landing Page Designer / Developer – High-Converting Pages (Long-Term)



We are looking for a **highly skilled and experienced funnel and landing page specialist** to design and build high-converting landing pages for our
, Instagram, and Google Ads campaigns.



We work across multiple industries, primarily **Health & Wellness, Supplements, Dental Tourism, Beauty, and other lead generation and e-commerce niches.**



We are not looking for someone who simply builds attractive websites. We need someone who understands **conversion rate optimization (CRO), direct-response marketing, consumer psychology, and how to turn paid advertising traffic into leads and customers.**



### Responsibilities



- Design and develop high-converting landing pages and complete sales funnels for paid advertising campaigns.

- Build lead generation funnels for services such as dental tourism, including consultation forms, appointment bookings, and qualification steps.

- Create product landing pages and sales funnels for supplements, wellness products, and e-commerce brands.

- Develop different funnel formats, including advertorials, pre-sell pages, product sales pages, quiz funnels, and multi-step lead forms.

- Research competitors and analyze successful landing pages to identify effective layouts, messaging, and conversion strategies.

- Write or improve persuasive headlines, sales copy, calls to action, and page structure.

- Create clean, professional, mobile-first designs optimized for conversions.

- Integrate tracking tools, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Conversion API where needed.

- Improve page loading speed, user experience, and overall conversion rates.

- Create landing page variations for A/B testing and ongoing optimization.



### Requirements



- **Proven experience building high-converting landing pages for
, Instagram, and Google Ads traffic.**

- Previous experience with **Health & Wellness, Supplements, Dental Tourism, or other competitive lead generation niches.**

- Strong understanding of direct-response marketing, sales funnels, and CRO.

- Experience building both lead generation and direct-to-consumer sales funnels.

- Ability to handle the full process, from initial concept and design to development and publishing.

- Strong knowledge of mobile optimization, page speed, and conversion tracking.

- Experience with tools such as **WordPress, Elementor, Webflow, ClickFunnels, GoHighLevel, Shopify, Unbounce**, or similar platforms.

- Understanding of advertising policies, particularly for health-related products and services.



### What We're Looking For



We need someone who understands that **a landing page is not just a website — it's a sales tool.**



You should be able to review a product or service, understand the target audience, analyze competitors, and independently develop a funnel designed to convert paid advertising traffic.



For example:



**Dental Tourism:** A landing page that builds trust, explains treatment options, highlights legitimate patient experiences, and encourages visitors to request a consultation or treatment quote.



**Health & Supplements:** A conversion-focused landing page using compelling product messaging, educational content, benefits supported by evidence, customer reviews, and a clear purchasing process.



We want someone who can combine **professional design, persuasive copywriting, technical development, and conversion optimization** into one complete solution.



### Project Details



- **Industries:** Health & Wellness, Supplements, Dental Tourism, Beauty, E-commerce, and other categories

- **Traffic sources:** Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other paid advertising platforms

- **Project types:** Landing pages, lead generation funnels, sales funnels, advertorials, quiz funnels, and pre-sell pages

- **Work type:** Remote, long-term collaboration

- **Volume:** Multiple ongoing projects across different brands



### How to Apply



Please include:



1. **Your portfolio with links to live landing pages and funnels you have personally built.**

2. Examples of landing pages created specifically for paid advertising campaigns.

3. Previous experience in Dental Tourism, Supplements, Health & Wellness, or similar niches.

4. Conversion rates or other campaign performance results from your previous projects, if available.

5. Which platforms and tools you use to build funnels.

6. Whether you handle design, copywriting, development, and tracking yourself.

7. Your **price per completed landing page**, including design and development.

8. Your pricing for complete multi-step funnels and ongoing optimization.



**Important:** We are specifically looking for someone with proven experience building conversion-focused funnels, not general website designers.



We want to establish a **long-term partnership with a specialist who can consistently deliver professional, high-performing landing pages and help us improve results across multiple advertising campaigns.**

title: # Hiring Expert Instagram Feed Designer – Creative Collages & Premium Social Media Content (Long-Term)
description:
# Hiring Expert Instagram Feed Designer – Creative Collages & Premium Social Media Content (Long-Term)



We are looking for a **highly creative and experienced Instagram graphic designer** to create visually stunning, eye-catching Instagram feed posts for multiple brands across different industries.



Our goal is to build **premium, modern, and visually consistent Instagram feeds** using creative collages, strong typography, unique layouts, and engaging visual concepts.



We are not looking for someone who simply uses basic Canva templates. We need a designer with **excellent visual taste, creativity, and a strong understanding of modern Instagram design trends.**



### Responsibilities



- Design high-quality, visually engaging Instagram feed posts.

- Create **creative collage-style designs** combining images, typography, textures, graphic elements, and unique compositions.

- Develop modern, premium, and aesthetically appealing Instagram layouts.

- Design carousel posts, promotional graphics, editorial-style content, and branded visuals.

- Maintain a consistent visual identity across the Instagram feed while keeping every post fresh and interesting.

- Research current Instagram design trends and develop original creative concepts.

- Create visually connected posts that look attractive both individually and together on the Instagram profile grid.

- Work across different industries, including business, luxury, lifestyle, health, beauty, and consumer brands.

- Use professional design tools and AI-generated visuals when appropriate.



### Requirements



- **Proven experience designing premium Instagram feed content and creative collage-style posts.**

- Strong portfolio showcasing modern Instagram designs, especially collages, editorial layouts, and creative typography.

- Excellent understanding of composition, color combinations, spacing, and visual storytelling.

- Ability to create unique designs rather than repeating generic templates.

- Strong skills in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or similar design tools.

- Experience designing cohesive Instagram grids and multi-slide carousel posts.

- Ability to adapt design styles to different brands and industries.

- Strong creative thinking and attention to detail.



### What We're Looking For



We want a designer who can make an Instagram profile look **professional, premium, creative, and visually impressive.**



The ideal candidate should be able to take basic content, images, or a short brief and transform them into **beautiful, attention-grabbing Instagram posts**.



We particularly like:



- **Modern collage designs** with layered images, cutouts, textures, and creative compositions.

- **Editorial and magazine-inspired layouts** with strong typography.

- **Premium, minimal, and luxury-inspired designs** where appropriate.

- Creative carousel posts with engaging layouts and smooth visual storytelling.

- Consistent branding without making every post look identical.



We value designers who can bring their own ideas, experiment with different visual styles, and consistently produce content that stands out.



### Project Details



- **Platform:** Instagram

- **Content:** Feed posts, creative collages, carousels, branded graphics

- **Formats:** 4:5 (1080 × 1350) and other Instagram-compatible sizes

- **Industries:** Business, Luxury, Lifestyle, Health & Wellness, Beauty, and other categories

- **Work type:** Remote, long-term collaboration

- **Volume:** Ongoing content production for multiple Instagram accounts



### How to Apply



Please include:



1. **Your portfolio of Instagram feed designs**, particularly creative collages and editorial-style posts.

2. Links to Instagram accounts you have designed content for.

3. Examples of complete Instagram grids or cohesive feed designs.

4. Which tools you use for graphic design and creative production.

5. Your **price per single Instagram post**.

6. Your price per carousel (5–10 slides).

7. Your pricing for monthly packages of 15–30 posts.

8. How many high-quality designs you can deliver per week.



**Important:** We are specifically looking for designers with strong artistic direction and experience creating premium, visually distinctive Instagram content. Generic template-based portfolios will not be considered.



We are looking for a **long-term creative partner** who can help us build beautiful, recognizable Instagram feeds across multiple brands.

We're a multi-chain DeFi protocol building LP Bonds, a new liquidity primitive that locks liquidity long-term while keeping user positions tradable. We need Business Development partners who can introduce us to crypto launchpads, DEXs, chains, and established crypto projects.



We're live on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, ApeChain, BSC, Abstract, and Monad, with integrations running on Camelot DEX, HELLO DEX, and PancakeSwap. See it yourself: 



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗬



Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.



𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡



Base Pay: $10/hour, 10 hours/week ($100/week). Paid 50% in Ethereum (ETH) and 50% in $GMI tokens on an 18-month vesting schedule, building you a long-term position in the multi-chain $GMI ecosystem.



Minimum Requirement: 1 qualified appointment per week. A qualified appointment means a scheduled call that actually takes place between me and a decision-maker (founder, BD lead, or marketing head) at a crypto launchpad, DEX, chain, or established project, and meets our qualification criteria. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay. All appointments and outreach are logged in our tracker; unlogged work doesn't count or pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).



Commission: 20% of ALL upgrade fees generated by each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.



Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. No ceiling.



Commission is paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



Together with our referral program, we give nearly all of our upgrade revenue back to the people who grow the protocol. Every partnership you land gets its own fresh 180-day earning window.



𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗦 𝗟𝗜𝗞𝗘 𝗜𝗡 𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗟 𝗠𝗢𝗡𝗘𝗬 (𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽):



Mints $50,000 in bonds: $1,500 launch bonus paid as it happens, plus 20% of every upgrade fee as they roll in

Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



That's ONE introduction. Land three and run the math.



Note: A successful partnership means a project you introduced signs the LP Bonds integration agreement and goes live on our marketplace. You book the qualified call, I run the deal and close it.



𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗛𝗔𝗩𝗘:



Existing connections in crypto (launchpads, DEXs, chains, established projects)

/
 relationships with project founders or marketing heads

Understanding of DeFi/crypto space

Hunger to earn based on results, not hours



𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗗𝗢𝗡'𝗧 𝗡𝗘𝗘𝗗:



To close deals (I handle that)

Any upfront investment

Previous BD experience (connections matter more)



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘:



Your job is booking qualified calls. You reach into your network, find decision-makers at crypto projects, and get them on a scheduled call with me. I close the deals, you collect appointment bonuses, commissions, and launch bonuses as your partnerships go live and grow.



Ready to turn your crypto connections into serious income?



𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗟𝗬 𝗪𝗜𝗧𝗛:



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word BONDS

List 3-5 crypto projects/launchpads you have connections with

Your
 handle

Brief description of your crypto involvement

Tell me about a time you got someone onto a call after they ignored your first message



We need partners who see the opportunity and want to run with it.

title: DeFi Partnerships Manager: Run the Reps, Book the Calls, Earn Uncapped Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Book Editor/ Proofreader | Gig | Remote| $7-$8/hour
description:
Book Editor / Proofreader — Leadership & Personal Development Book | Gig | Remote| $7-$8/hour|



Job Type: Project-Based / Contract

Schedule: Flexible (must meet hard deadline)

Compensation: $7–$8/hr USD (based on experience and turnaround speed)

Openings: 1

Deadline: Completed edit due by October 12, 2026 or sooner



About the Role



We are looking for a skilled book editor and proofreader to line edit an 80,000-word leadership and personal development book on a tight timeline. The manuscript needs a thorough line edit and proofread — no formatting or layout work is required (page formatting for KDP will be handled separately by another team member).



This is a time-sensitive, project-based engagement with a hard deadline of October 12, 2026. We need someone who can turn this around quickly and deliver polished, publication-ready copy.



The client is a US-based leadership coaching organization, so the content will center on personal growth, leadership principles, and coaching frameworks.



Core Responsibilities



Line Editing (50%): Review the full 80,000-word manuscript for clarity, sentence structure, flow, readability, and tone consistency. Ensure ideas are communicated effectively and transitions between sections are smooth.

Proofreading & Grammar (40%): Correct spelling, punctuation, grammar, and typographical errors throughout the manuscript. Ensure consistency in style, capitalization, hyphenation, and formatting of names/terms.

Style & Consistency Review (10%): Flag or resolve inconsistencies in terminology, voice, and formatting conventions across chapters. Apply standard editorial conventions (Chicago Manual of Style or AP Style as appropriate for nonfiction/self-help).



What We're Looking For



Proven experience editing and proofreading long-form nonfiction manuscripts (50,000+ words)

Strong command of English grammar, punctuation, and style conventions

Ability to complete a full edit of an 80,000-word manuscript within 3–5 days

Familiarity with Google Docs or Microsoft Word track changes/suggesting mode

Excellent attention to detail and consistency

Reliable communication and ability to meet hard deadlines without reminders

Portfolio or samples of previous book editing work (required)



Nice to Have



Experience editing in the leadership, coaching, personal development, or self-help genre

Familiarity with KDP (Kindle Direct Publishing) manuscript requirements

Experience with style guides (Chicago Manual of Style preferred for nonfiction)

Prior work with independent authors or small publishing teams

References from previous book editing clients

title: Sales Development Representative – B2B Outbound Appointment Setting | Full-Time | Remote | $7–$8/hr
description:
Sales Development Representative – B2B Outbound Appointment Setting | Full-Time | Remote | $7–$8/hr

Location: Remote, Philippines-based only

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday to Friday

Work Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM AEST / 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM Philippine Time

Compensation: $7–$8 USD/hour, depending on experience

Type: 90-Day Pilot, with potential for long-term continuation based on performance

Industry: Dental / Orthodontic SaaS



About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Sales Development Representative to support an Australian dental/orthodontic SaaS company. This role is focused on booking qualified meetings with dental and orthodontic practices using an existing HubSpot list. You will not be responsible for closing sales, pricing, quoting, or running demos. Your main job is to work the list, understand the account history, reach out professionally, qualify interest, and book meetings with the sales representative. This is a phone-first role. The right candidate must be confident making outbound calls, speaking with practice owners or practice managers, and logging all activity properly in HubSpot.



What You’ll Do

Work the Existing HubSpot List

Review target accounts already listed in HubSpot

Read prior calls, emails, meeting notes, deal stages, and contact history before outreach

Understand why an account went quiet or what happened in previous conversations

Segment prospects based on account history and level of prior engagement

Build outreach that matches the prospect’s situation



Outbound Calling & Email Outreach

Make outbound calls to dental and orthodontic practices

Send follow-up emails using the company email alias

Use HubSpot sequences, tasks, and meeting links

Follow up with warm, lapsed, and previously engaged leads

Adjust messaging based on what prospects say on the phone

Maintain a professional and confident tone during all conversations



Qualify and Book Meetings

Qualify prospects based on fit, decision-maker involvement, and real interest

Book qualified intro calls or demo calls directly into the sales representative’s calendar

Attach the proper context and account history so the sales representative is prepared

Focus on completed meetings, not just booked meetings

Confirm meetings at the time of booking

Send reminders before meetings

Reschedule quickly when a prospect cancels



CRM Discipline

Log every call, email, note, and meeting in HubSpot

Keep records clean and updated at the contact level

Use the correct meeting types, such as Intro Call and Demo Call

Avoid side spreadsheets or disconnected tracking

Maintain accurate activity and meeting records



Weekly Reporting

Report weekly on:

Outreach activity

Meetings booked

Meetings completed

List coverage

Objections heard on the phone

Follow-up opportunities

Participate in weekly call reviews and coaching

Use feedback to improve messaging, objection handling, and meeting quality



Performance Goals

This is a 90-day pilot role. Success will be measured by completed meetings, meaning the prospect actually shows up.

Expected meeting goals:



Month 1: 8 completed meetings

Month 2: 12 completed meetings

Month 3: 16 completed meetings

Total Pilot Goal: 36 completed meetings in 90 days



A booked meeting that no-shows does not count as a completed meeting.



Required Experience

2+ years of B2B outbound experience

Experience in cold calling, appointment setting, inside sales, or SDR work

Ability to discuss previous sales numbers, appointment-setting results, or outbound activity metrics

Clear, confident, neutral spoken English

Comfortable speaking with business owners, practice owners, or practice managers

Strong CRM discipline

HubSpot experience preferred, but other CRM experience is acceptable

Comfortable working Australian business hours

No issue with a 6:00 AM Philippine Time start

Reliable computer and work setup

Noise-cancelling headset

Backup internet and power plan

Preferred Experience

Dental, orthodontic, healthcare, medical device, SaaS, or B2B service sales experience

Experience working warm, lapsed, or previously contacted lead lists

Experience reviewing CRM history before outreach

Experience using HubSpot sequences, tasks, and meeting links

Experience booking meetings for another sales representative

Experience working Australian or U.S. business hours

What This Role Is Not



This is not a closing role.



This is not a pricing, quoting, or discounting role.



This is not a demo role.



This is not a general admin role.



This role is focused on outbound calls, email follow-up, CRM discipline, and booking qualified meetings.



What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



Confident on the phone

Comfortable with outbound calling

Strong in English communication

Organized and disciplined with CRM updates

Able to read account history and personalize outreach

Consistent with follow-up

Comfortable being measured by completed meetings

Coachable and open to call reviews

Reliable during Australian business hours

Focused on quality meetings, not just call volume

To Apply



Please send:



1. A viewable link to your updated resume

2. A short paragraph describing your B2B outbound, SDR, appointment-setting, or inside sales experience

3. A short voice or video introduction so we can evaluate spoken English and phone readiness

4. Confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM Philippine Time

5. Confirmation that you have a reliable computer, noise-cancelling headset, backup internet, and backup power plan

6. Your desired hourly rate

title: Sales Development Representative (Inbound + Outbound) | Full Time | $7 to $8/hr
description:
Sales Development Representative (Inbound + Outbound) | Full Time | $7 to $8/hr

Location: Remote, Philippines based candidates only

Schedule: Full Time, 40 hours/week, Long Term

Work Hours: 7:00am to 3:30pm Pacific Time (10:00pm to 6:30am Philippine Time), with a 30 minute unpaid lunch

Compensation: $7 to $8 USD/hour based on experience



Please confirm you can work this overnight Philippine schedule before applying.



About the Role

We are hiring a Sales Development Representative for a virtual staffing company that places Filipino virtual assistants with dental, orthodontic, and healthcare practices in the U.S.

You will be the first voice a prospect hears. You will answer new inquiries the same day, qualify them, and run discovery calls. You will also work through the company's database of past leads who never converted and re-open those conversations.

This is not a purely reactive role. You will be expected to generate pipeline, not just respond to it.



Must Haves (Non-Negotiable)

If you cannot check every box below, please do not apply.



1. You have 1+ years of sales, SDR, or business development experience that included live phone calls with prospects.

2. You have personally run inbound lead qualification and discovery calls.

3. You have personally run outbound outreach (calls,
, follow-up sequences) to cold or stalled leads.

4. You have hands-on HubSpot experience, including managing deal stages, notes, and next steps.

6. You can work 7:00am to 3:30pm Pacific Time (10:00pm to 6:30am Philippine Time) and have reliable internet and a quiet home office for calls.



Nice to Haves

Experience selling to dental, orthodontic, or healthcare practices

A track record of reviving cold leads into closed deals



What You'll Do

Inbound

Qualify leads by understanding the practice's staffing needs, pain points, and timeline

Run discovery and intro calls that clearly explain the VA placement model and pricing

Move qualified leads through the HubSpot pipeline, keeping stages, notes, and next steps current

Outbound

Segment and prioritize outbound lists by likely fit and prior engagement

Run consistent follow-up cadences (calls,
, and other approved channels) to re-engage cold leads

Log every touchpoint in HubSpot so nothing falls through the cracks

General

Keep HubSpot clean and current across inbound and outbound pipelines

Hit monthly and quarterly targets (calls made, discovery calls booked, deals closed)

Represent the company's value proposition consistently and professionally on every call



How to Apply

Submit all 4 items. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



1. Resume: A viewable link (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.). Make sure sharing is set to "anyone with the link can view."

2. Experience paragraph (4 to 6 sentences total): Briefly cover your experience with:

Inbound lead qualification and discovery calls

Outbound prospecting and re-engaging cold leads

HubSpot pipeline management

3. Revived deal example: A short written description of one deal you personally revived from a cold or stalled lead. Please include:

The industry and type of lead

What you did differently to re-engage them

The result (booked call, closed deal, etc.)

4. Voice sample: A link to a 60 to 90 second recording (Loom, Vocaroo, or similar) of you introducing yourself and explaining how you would open a discovery call with a dental practice owner.

title: Ecommerce manager
description:
E-commerce Manager



About STUDIOCULT



STUDIOCULT is a Brooklyn-based, online jewelry brand highly regarded for our inventive designs. We run on Shopify, sell worldwide, and take both our craft and our sense of humor seriously. We're looking for an A player who wants to join an innovative company that also respects work-life balance. Our work culture is effective but relaxed. We're a big fan of the honor system here. 



The Role



We're looking for an E-commerce Manager to own the day-to-day health and growth of studiocult.co and our marketplace channels. You'll keep the site fast, accurate and compliant; run tests and dig into the data to improve the shopping experience; keep launches and restocks running smoothly; and make sure our products look great wherever our customers shop.



This is a hands-on role for someone who doesn't wait to be told. You'll learn how things work today, write it down, and then come to us with ideas to make it better.



This is a fully remote, full-time position. 



What You'll Do



Research, testing & analytics

- Proactively audit the storefront and recommend improvements to the front-end experience

- Oversee the web developer and report to the COO, Implementing the CO's instructions.

- Run competitor site comparisons and bring back what's worth borrowing (and what to avoid)

- Propose, plan, and run A/B tests, then report results and recommend next steps

- Track site performance in Shopify Analytics, Triple Whale, GA4 and turn the numbers into clear recommendations

- Use heatmaps and session recordings (e.g. Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar) to find where shoppers get stuck

- Site management & performance

- Configure and maintain collections, pages, navigation, menus and other storefront settings

- Keep product pages, merchandising and site content accurate and up to date

- Monitor site speed: compress images, use lazy loading, and flag apps that slow the theme down

- Handle on-page SEO, including meta titles and descriptions, alt text, URL structure and product schema

- QA every change on mobile and desktop before it goes live

- Launches, drops & promotions

- Schedule and QA product drops and restocks so launches go live without surprises

- Build discount codes, automatic discounts and sales without breaking pricing

- Work alongside
/SMS (e.g. Klaviyo) when flows and campaigns touch the site



Catalog & product data

- Manage products and variants

- Keep listings accurate on jewelry-specific details: materials, plating, sizing guides and care info

- Maintain product feeds for Google Merchant Center and the Meta catalog

- Compliance & accessibility

- Make sure regular ADA / accessibility scans are ran and coordinate fixes

- Maintain cookie consent, privacy settings and related legal requirements

- Make sure promotional tools (e.g. countdown timers, pop-ups) follow best practices and applicable rules

- Stay current on e-commerce compliance and platform best practices



Video & media

- Prep video for web and social: compressing, cropping, SDR conversion, optimizing file size and load time, and time remapping

- Make small banner and storefront graphic updates without waiting on a designer

- Keep media assets organized in Air



Apps & automation

- Own and maintain our app stack, including Gorgias, Intelligems, Redo and others)

- Build and maintain Shopify Flow automations

- Evaluate new apps and integrations when needs come up

- Research latest apps and make recommendations for which will be useful for the business



Marketplace & channel listings

- Create and manage product listings on TikTok Shop, Faire and other channels

- Support TikTok Shop creator and affiliate tools (e.g. Euka)

- Keep catalog data, pricing and inventory consistent across channels



Documentation & process

- Write and maintain SOPs for recurring tasks so knowledge doesn't live in one person's head

- Track work and projects in our project management tool



What We're Looking For

- 2–4 years of hands-on Shopify experience (store admin, theme settings, apps)

- Experience running or supporting A/B tests and acting on the results

- Comfortable in Shopify Analytics and GA4, and with spreadsheets (pivot tables, XLOOKUP)

- Working knowledge of site speed and on-page SEO best practices

- Experience with bulk product management (CSV, Matrixify or similar) and product feeds

- Experience running product launches, restocks and promotions on Shopify

- Familiarity with accessibility, cookie consent and e-commerce compliance basics

- Comfortable editing and optimizing video for web

- Experience with marketplace listings (TikTok Shop, Faire or similar)

- Experience with a project management tool such as Notion, Asana or ClickUp

- Strong written English and clear async communication, including documenting processes

- Self-starter who spots problems and proposes solutions without being asked

- Detail-oriented, with a QA mindset across many small, ongoing tasks



Bonus points

- Taste. You have a good eye and can tell when something looks off-brand

- You're passionate about subcultures, internet culture, fashion or jewelry

- Experience with Gorgias, Intelligems, Redo, Shopify Flow or Air specifically

- Experience with heatmap and session-recording tools (Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar)

- Familiarity with Klaviyo or another
/SMS platform

- Light design skills in Figma or Photoshop

- Basic/intermediate HTML/CSS/Liquid knowledge



Details

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time, contractor

Hours: US hours 10AM - 6PM Eastern

Compensation: 12-16 USD/hour (based on experience)

Reports to: COO

Healthcare: insurance provided after a 1-month probationary period. 



How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note to us telling us about a Shopify store you've worked on and one thing you'd change about studiocult.co. Links to stores, test results or a portfolio are a plus.

**Position:** Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist



## About the Role



Circle of Greatness is looking for a highly detail-oriented **Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist** to serve as the final checkpoint before client-facing work is released.



The ideal candidate has an exceptional eye for detail and enjoys finding errors, testing functionality, and making sure that every deliverable meets the expected quality standards before it goes live.



You will review different types of digital assets, including copy, graphics, funnels, landing pages,
s, SMS campaigns, paid ads, event materials, videos, reports, and proposals.



## Key Responsibilities



- Review client-facing deliverables before release to ensure accuracy, consistency, functionality, and quality.

- Review copy for spelling, grammar, punctuation, consistency, brand voice, product information, pricing, and other important details.

- Review graphics for text accuracy, branding, image quality, dimensions, cropping, mobile readability, and overall consistency.

- Test funnels and landing pages, including links, buttons, forms, checkouts, upsells, thank-you pages, tags, automations, and tracking.

- Review
 and SMS campaigns for links, merge fields, sender information, formatting, and functionality.

- Review event materials to confirm dates, times, time zones, speaker information, links, and other important details.

title: Full Charge Bookkeeper / Accounting Manager
description:
About the role:

We are hiring one person to own day to day finance across a small portfolio of ecommerce businesses: paying bills, collecting what we are owed, reconciling every card and bank account, and keeping COGS accurate by SKU. You will report directly to the founder and CEO and work alongside our outside CPA, who handles tax and year end.

This is a hands on role. You will do the work yourself, not manage a team, and you will be the single source of truth for where our money is on any given day.



What you will own

Payments and accounts payable

- Enter every vendor bill, manufacturer invoice, freight bill, and contractor invoice within 2 business days of receipt

- Run a weekly payment cycle; payments over $2,500 require CEO approval

- Maintain a 30 day cash outlook so large payments (inventory POs, duties, freight) never surprise us



Accounts receivable

- Invoice clients on the 1st of each month and track every open invoice

- Follow up on anything 7 days past due; escalate anything 30 days past due

- Reconcile wholesale and B2B receivables



Credit cards and bank accounts

- Reconcile every credit card and bank account monthly, by the 10th

- Code every transaction to the right entity and account; flag anything without a receipt or a clear business purpose

- Catch duplicate charges, unused subscriptions, and fees we should dispute



COGS and inventory

- Maintain landed cost per SKU: product cost plus inbound freight, duties, prep, and 3PL fees

- Record COGS monthly based on units sold across Amazon, Shopify, and other channels

- Track inventory value across FBA, our 3PL, and in transit shipments; reconcile to physical counts quarterly



Amazon and marketplace accounting

- Reconcile Amazon settlement reports (fees, refunds, reimbursements, ad spend, reserves) through A2X or Link My Books

- Reconcile Shopify, TikTok Shop, and payment processor payouts to the bank



Month end and reporting

- Close the books for each entity by the 15th of the following month

- Deliver a monthly P&L, balance sheet, AR/AP aging, and cash position for each company

- Prepare clean books and supporting schedules for our CPA at tax time



What you bring

Required

- 4+ years as a full charge bookkeeper, staff accountant, or accounting manager

- 2+ years doing the books for an ecommerce or consumer products company with physical inventory

- Hands on Amazon settlement reconciliation experience

- Expert in QuickBooks Online or Xero

- Experience keeping books for 2 or more entities at once

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills: lookups, pivot tables, building a landed cost model from scratch

- Comfortable owning deadlines with no one checking on you
