title: Airbnb STR Remote Virtual Assistant
description:
We are seeking an experienced Virtual Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of our fast-growing short-term rental management company. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on guest communication, cleaning and maintenance coordination, administrative support, and timely completion of operational tasks.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple properties and competing priorities. You will be expected to take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish, resolve routine issues independently, and communicate clearly when additional support or approval is needed.



Work Schedule

- Full-time, fully remote: 40 scheduled hours per week, 8 hours per day.

- Flexible with shift schedules: Morning shift: 8am - 4pm, Evening shift: 4pm - 12am, Admin shift: 10am - 6pm.

- You must be flexible with all the shift schedules, including weekends. The schedule follows U.S. Pacific Time.



Note that all assigned work must be completed personally. Delegating or outsourcing work to sub-VAs or other individuals is strictly prohibited.





Key Responsibilities

Guest Communication & Reservation Support

- Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries through Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, direct-booking channels,
, and phone.

- Support guests throughout their stay, including booking inquiries, check-in instructions, access issues, amenity questions, and checkout.

- Resolve routine guest concerns and complaints within established policies and approval limits. Escalate urgent, sensitive, or high-cost issues with a clear summary and recommended next steps.

- Review reservation details, calendars, and special requests to identify potential issues and ensure accurate information.

- Assist with guest reviews, damage claims, disputes, and platform support cases by gathering documentation and following up.



Cleaning, Maintenance & Vendor Coordination

- Coordinate cleaning schedules and confirm that properties are ready before guest arrival.

- Follow up with cleaners on completion status, turnover photos, missing supplies, and reported property issues.

- Contact and coordinate with maintenance technicians, handymen, landscapers, and other service providers.

- Source vendors, request quotes, confirm availability, and arrange approved services.

- Track cleaning and maintenance issues through completion, verify that the work has been completed, and keep relevant parties informed.



Administrative & Listing Support

- Create and update property listings, descriptions, photos, amenities, house rules, and check-in instructions as assigned.

- Maintain accurate property information, guest records, vendor contacts, and operational documentation.

- Complete assigned updates in Hostaway, PriceLabs, and OTA platforms according to established procedures.

- Monitor listing alerts, guest feedback, and account notifications; flag issues promptly and complete required follow-up.

- Assist with property onboarding and setup on additional booking channels by organizing information and completing assigned configuration tasks.



Task Ownership & Operational Follow-Through

- Manage your assigned inboxes, tickets, and task queues, prioritizing time-sensitive guest and property issues.

- Take ownership of tasks from initial request through confirmed resolution—not just forwarding messages or creating tickets.

- Maintain clear notes on actions taken, current status, deadlines, and next steps so others can follow the work without unnecessary back-and-forth.

- Provide end-of-shift updates covering completed tasks, unresolved issues, pending approvals, and follow-up needs.

- Follow company SOPs, flag gaps or recurring problems, and suggest practical improvements based on day-to-day experience.





Qualifications

- Proven hands-on experience supporting short-term rentals on Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, or similar platforms.

- Familiarity with STR PMS.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence communicating with guests and vendors by phone.

- Experience coordinating cleaning, maintenance, or other property-related services.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple properties, conversations, and deadlines.

- Sound judgment and problem-solving skills: able to handle routine issues independently, recognize urgency, and know when to escalate.

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable, with a strong habit of following up without repeated reminders.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and learning new software, tools, and procedures.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable computer and headset, and a quiet workspace for guest and vendor calls.

- Ability to consistently work the required Pacific Time schedule and provide the stated standby availability.

How to Apply



Growth Opportunity

Top-performing Virtual Assistants may have the opportunity to advance into a VA Manager role as the company grows.



Please submit your application and complete every question in the application form. Only applicants who complete the full form will be considered.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
We're Hiring: Marketing Assistant

Location: 100% remote (based in Philippines)

_________________________________________________

Hi! I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - one of the fastest-growing home brands in the US, redefining how people experience modern dining and everyday elegance.



Our vision is simple: when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware (with household appliances on the way), they think JazzUpCo. We’ve already served over 100,000 customers and are now building a global, design-first homeware brand.



At JazzUpCo, growth comes from turning great ideas into great execution. As we continue to scale across multiple channels - from Shopify and Amazon to retail and wholesale - strong operations become increasingly important.



We’re looking for a Marketing Assistant to join our team. In this role, you will split your time between driving our Amazon channel expansion and keeping the supply chain humming through weekly inventory checks and fulfilment routines.

_________________________________________________



Role Overview



First 3–6 Months Focus

- 70% Amazon & Creative Support: Daily reporting, Amazon listing/catalog updates, case management, and creative QA for Meta ads/landing pages.



- 30% Marketing Operations & Collaborations: Managing ClickUp systems, creator/affiliate partnerships, product launch timelines, and website/multichannel tasks.



Long-Term Focus (6th Month Onward)

- 50% Amazon & Marketing Channel Operations: Owning routine Seller Central operations, forecasting, FBA shipments, and monthly performance dashboarding.



- 50% Partnerships, Creative Ops & Special Projects: Independently running creator/affiliate inbound/outbound programs, creative asset coordination, and cross-functional task tracking.



Amazon Management & Support

- Update daily sales and performance reports, monitor daily account health (compliance and listings suppression), and submit/manage Seller Central support cases.



- Build and manage biweekly FBA shipment creations (3 hrs) and maintain biweekly forecasting reports (1 hr) to support inventory alignment.



- Execute listing updates, upload image swatches (30–45 min), build/edit Premium A+ Content (30–45 min), and process multichannel orders as needed.



- Track customer reviews and product feedback on a weekly basis to flag actionable listing issues.



Marketing Operations & Assistant Support

- Act as the ClickUp project keeper (30 min–1 hr daily) to ensure task completion, monitor project workflows, and follow up on deliverable timelines.



- Maintain product launch timelines, ensuring cross-team awareness of critical dates and milestones.



- Maintain and update monthly marketing dashboards, tagging relevant stakeholders for input and review.



- Track creative briefs for external photography (Yu), ensuring assets are produced, approved, and routed on time.



Creative QA & Meta Ad Support

- Double-check landing page links on Meta Ads to verify correct product alignment and smooth user experience.



- Review editor-submitted videos and graphics for brand guideline compliance, then download and organize files in Google Drive.



- Assist with weekly monitoring and tracking of Meta Ad tasks in ClickUp.

_________________________________________________



You’re a Fit If You Have:



- Experience in building listings, uploading assets, setting up A+ Content, and managing FBA routines.



- Comfortable providing ad support by tracking keywords, impressions, and basic campaign performance metrics.



- Natural organizer who ensures processes are followed and deliverables hit their target dates.



- Comfortable with spreadsheets, order splits, warehouse clearing, and tracking overstock or out-of-stock risks.



- Friendly and professional when managing incoming creator collaborations and basic website updates.



- Detail-oriented mindset that spots typos in listings or stock count errors before they cause issues.



- Adaptable team player who thrives switching between creative marketing tasks and practical operations support.

_________________________________________________



Why Join JazzUpCo?



- 100% Remote



- Fast Growth, Real Ownership – Your work directly impacts our product performance and global expansion.



- Paid Time Off & Benefits



- Learning & Career Path – Learn directly from the founder and consultants while sharpening your strategic project management skills and growing into a senior operations leader.



-Growth-Focused Culture – We’re big on learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.



- Not just a number in the org chart – Every team member is heard, supported, and part of the journey and your voice is actually heard.

_________________________________________________



Our Culture: E-F-G



E - Excel

We don’t believe in coasting. If we’re going to do something, we do it well - with care, thought, and pride in the details.



F - Fulfilment

It’s not just about the work we do - it’s how we feel doing it. We build things that excite us, challenge us, and make us proud.



G - Growth

The best journeys bring out your best. This role is designed to sharpen your skills, push your thinking, and grow with you - with mentorship, feedback, and the space to lead.

_________________________________________________



Next Steps:



1) Apply: Via the application form -
 (OJPH)

2) First Interview: Get to know each other

3) Trial Task: Show us how you think and execute

4) Join the Team: Onboarding + probation --> full-time hire



We can’t wait to meet you!

description:
We are a growing UK e-Commerce company looking for an experienced and hands-on Customer Support Manager to lead a small remote customer support team.



We are looking for someone who combines strong people-management skills with excellent attention to detail and customer service standards. You will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day performance of the team, auditing customer interactions, providing coaching and feedback, and ensuring every customer receives professional, accurate, and high-quality support.



Key Responsibilities



1. Team Management

• Manage and support a small remote customer support team

• Monitor daily team performance, workload, attendance, and productivity

• Allocate and prioritise tasks to ensure customer enquiries are handled efficiently

• Provide regular coaching, guidance, and performance feedback

• Support team members in resolving complex or escalated customer issues

• Set clear expectations and ensure team members consistently follow company procedures

• Identify training needs and provide appropriate coaching and support

• Maintain a positive, accountable, and collaborative remote working environment



2. Quality Assurance & Ticket Auditing

• Regularly audit customer support tickets,
s, and customer interactions

• Evaluate the quality, accuracy, professionalism, and tone of customer responses

• Ensure agents provide clear, helpful, and accurate information

• Check that company policies and procedures are being followed correctly

• Identify recurring errors, knowledge gaps, and areas for improvement

• Provide constructive feedback and coaching based on ticket audits

• Track quality trends and report significant issues to management

• Help develop and maintain customer service standards, templates, and procedures



3. Customer Support Operations

• Monitor the support queue and ensure customer enquiries are handled within expected timeframes

• Assist with complex, sensitive, or escalated customer cases

• Ensure accurate documentation and case handling across support systems

• Work closely with other departments to resolve customer issues efficiently

• Identify recurring customer concerns and recommend improvements to internal processes

• Help improve workflows, FAQs, procedures, and support documentation

• Ensure the team consistently delivers a customer experience that reflects the GymSets brand



Requirements

• Previous experience managing or supervising a customer support or customer service team

• Experience managing a remote team is strongly preferred

• Strong understanding of customer service and quality assurance principles

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Exceptional attention to detail

• Strong ability to evaluate customer interactions objectively and consistently

• Confident providing constructive feedback and coaching to team members

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Able to handle escalated customer concerns professionally

• Highly organised with strong time-management skills

• Comfortable working with CRM, helpdesk, ticketing, and communication platforms

• Comfortable reviewing performance data and identifying trends

• Able to work independently and take ownership of team performance

• Experience in e-commerce customer support is an advantage

• Reliable high-speed internet connection

• Quiet and professional home working environment



What We Offer

• Full-time, fully remote position

• 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM UK Business Hours

• Long-term opportunity with a growing UK e-commerce company

• Comprehensive onboarding and documented procedures

• Supportive management and collaborative team environment

• Opportunities for professional growth as the business expands



Working Hours

9:00 AM to 5:00 PM UK Business Hours (Philippine Time: 4:00 PM to 12:00 AM)



How to Apply



Please submit your application with the subject line: Customer Support Manager – Your Full Name



Please include:

• Your updated CV or resume

• A brief introduction about yourself and your customer support management experience via voice recording or short video, maximum 1 minute

• Details of your previous experience managing remote teams

• Details of your experience with ticket auditing, quality assurance, coaching, or performance management

• Any experience working with CRM, helpdesk, or e-commerce platforms



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted for the next stage of the recruitment process.

title: Senior Instagram Growth + Conversion Strategist
description:
Senior Instagram Growth + Conversion Strategist

Extraordinary Love LLC • Reporting to Operations Manager • Remote



📍 ABOUT THE ROLE



Attract Extraordinary Love (
) is looking for an exceptional Senior Instagram Growth + Conversion Strategist to help us strategically grow Christine Campbell Pate's established personal brand from approximately 150K Instagram followers toward our first goal of 500K, while turning more of that audience into engaged leads, conversations, and paying customers.



This is NOT primarily a graphic design, social media management, or "post what we give you" role.



We need someone who understands both: GROWTH + CONVERSION.



You'll become deeply immersed in Christine's brand, audience, offers, messaging, and methodology until you understand our woman well enough to know what she needs to hear, see, learn, and believe to take the next step.



🎯 WHAT YOU'LL OWN



You'll help drive the strategy behind how we grow, engage, nurture, and convert our Instagram audience.



That includes:



✅ Developing an organic Instagram growth strategy focused on reaching more of the right people

✅ Planning content 30+ days ahead while leaving room to capitalize on what's working now

✅ Creating strategic ideas for Reels, hooks, Stories, carousels, testimonials, proof, and conversion content

✅ Helping us create content for both reach AND revenue

✅ Building Stories that generate replies, DMs, leads, and sales, without making every day feel like a pitch fest

✅ Using buyer psychology, direct-response copy, and strong CTAs to move followers toward the next step

✅ Reviewing Instagram analytics and turning the numbers into actual recommendations

✅ Running strategic tests around hooks, topics, formats, CTAs, Story sequences, and content angles

✅ Identifying what we should do more of, stop doing, and test next

✅ Staying ahead of Instagram trends and platform changes without blindly jumping on every shiny new trend



Basically: we're not looking for someone to fill a content calendar.



We want someone who can tell us what to create, why we're creating it, what result we're looking for, and what the data tells us to do next.



📩 TO APPLY



: 



For the purpose of checking your attention to detail, use "Instagram Strategist" in the subject line along with your favorite color.



Please send us:



👉 Your 3 strongest Instagram growth/conversion case studies

👉 Accounts you personally helped grow

👉 Screenshots or analytics showing the results

👉 Examples of Stories or content that generated leads or sales

👉 A quick explanation of exactly what you were responsible for

👉 Your availability

👉 Your time zone

👉 Your compensation expectations (hourly rate or monthly rate)



Finalists will complete a paid strategy/content test.



If you know how to turn personal brands into audiences, audiences into conversations, and conversations into customers, and you can prove you've done it, we want to hear from you. 🤍

title: SEO Specialist | Website Optimisation & Google Search Visibility
description:
Company: Australian Offshore Staffing Agency

Position: Freelance SEO Specialist

Job Type: One-Time Project | Remote

Payment: AUD $20 Fixed Fee (One-Time Payment)



JOB OVERVIEW



We are an Australian-based offshore staffing agency providing highly skilled Executive Assistants and operational support to businesses across Australia.



We are seeking an experienced SEO Specialist to optimise our website, improve our Google search visibility, and ensure our business is easily discoverable through Google Search.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Google Search & Indexing: Set up Google Search Console, submit our website sitemap, resolve indexing issues, and ensure our website is correctly configured for Google indexing.

- Website SEO: Optimise page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, mobile performance, and relevant search keywords.

- Branded Search Optimisation: Improve our website's visibility when potential customers search for our company name and its variations.

- Technical SEO: Identify and resolve technical issues affecting website indexing, crawling, performance, canonical URLs, and structured data.

- Keyword Research: Identify relevant Australian search keywords relating to offshore staffing, remote Executive Assistants, and business operational support.

- On-Page SEO: Optimise existing website content and service pages to improve relevance and organic search performance.

- SEO Reporting: Provide a clear summary of completed improvements, indexing status, and recommendations for future growth.



REQUIREMENTS



- Proven experience in technical SEO and website optimisation.

- Strong knowledge of Google Search Console, indexing, and sitemap submissions.

- Experience with keyword research, on-page SEO, and Google search rankings.

- Ability to independently identify and resolve website SEO issues.

- Excellent communication, reliability, and attention to detail.



COMMUNICATIONS & PROFESSIONAL EXPECTATIONS



We place a strong emphasis on reliability, responsiveness, and professional communication. Applicants must be proactive, provide timely updates, respond promptly to messages, and consistently follow through on agreed responsibilities and deadlines.



Shortlisted candidates will be added to a dedicated WhatsApp group chat for direct communication, project coordination, and progress updates.



PROJECT OBJECTIVE



Our primary objective is to establish a strong Google search presence, ensuring our official website is correctly indexed, technically optimised, and easily discoverable when customers search for our company name.



We are looking for someone who can implement practical improvements rather than simply provide generic SEO recommendations.



COMPENSATION



AUD $20 – Fixed, One-Time Project Fee



This is a one-time freelance assignment, not an ongoing or hourly position. The agreed payment covers the completed project deliverables.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send your application to: 



 Subject: SEO Specialist Application – [Your Full Name]



Your application must include:

- A brief overview of your SEO experience.

- Examples of websites you have successfully optimised.

- Your proposed approach to improving our Google search visibility.

- Your WhatsApp phone number, including country code, so we can add you to our dedicated project group chat if shortlisted.

- Confirmation that you accept the AUD $20 fixed project fee.



Important: Strong communication and prompt responses are essential. Shortlisted candidates are expected to remain responsive throughout the selection process and project.



Suitable applicants will be contacted directly regarding the next steps.

title: HIRING: AI VIDEO AD CREATIVE EDITOR – META ADS
description:

**Starting Salary: $700 USD/month**

**Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM**

**Salary Increase After 3 Months Based on Performance**



## ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing pure dropshipping company specializing in **men's products and fashion**.



We create and test new video creatives every week through *
 & Instagram Ads**.



We are looking for someone who can take a product and turn it into **high-quality, sales-focused AI video ads**.



This is not just a video editing job.



You need to understand:



**Product → Audience → Hook → Creative → Sale**



---



# YOUR JOB



You will handle the creative process from start to finish:



**Product Brief → Creative Concept → AI Assets → Editing → Finished Ad**



You will:



* Create **20+ usable video creatives per day**

* Create **9:16 vertical ads**

* Create videos around **12–15 seconds**

* Develop different hooks and marketing angles

* Generate AI images and videos

* Edit the final videos

* Create UGC-style ads

* Create product demos

* Create talking-head and lifestyle/product videos

* Add captions, B-roll, music and sound effects

* Make multiple variations of the same product



The goal is not to make one beautiful video.



The goal is to create **many creatives that can stop the scroll and sell the product.**



---



# REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* **2–4+ years** of professional video editing or advertising creative experience

* Real experience creating *
/Instagram video ads**

* Strong video editing skills

* Strong knowledge of **CapCut**

* Premiere Pro is a plus

* Strong understanding of **hooks and sales psychology**

* Understanding of pacing, storytelling, B-roll, captions and sound design

* Experience with **AI image & video generation**

* Experience creating UGC-style ads

* Experience creating product demos

* Experience creating talking-head and lifestyle/product visuals

* Strong AI prompting skills

* Ability to maintain **product and character consistency**

* Ability to troubleshoot AI generation problems

* Ability to create multiple creative angles quickly

* Strong English communication

* Organized, fast and detail-oriented

* Able to work independently

* Performance-focused and creative



---



# AI TOOLS



You should have experience with tools such as:



**CapCut • Google Flow/Veo • Kling • Seedance • Runway • ElevenLabs**



Or similar AI tools.



You should also be someone who **actively learns new AI tools** and looks for faster ways to create better ads.



---



# IMPORTANT



We primarily create **men's clothing ads for
**.



You need to understand the difference between:



**Making a video**



and



**Making a video that sells.**



You should be able to take a product brief or script, develop the concept, generate the AI assets, edit everything and deliver a polished ad.



**Product accuracy is extremely important.**



AI must not change the product's:



* Color

* Shape

* Design

* Logo

* Buttons

* Details

* Fit



---



# WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO IS



**FAST** – Can consistently produce 20+ creatives per day.



**CREATIVE** – Can find multiple ways to market the same product.



**MARKETING-MINDED** – Understands that the goal is sales, not just aesthetics.



**PROACTIVE** – Brings new ideas and doesn't need to be told everything.



**DETAIL-ORIENTED** – Catches AI mistakes and editing problems.



**AMBITIOUS** – Wants to improve, take on more responsibility and increase their income.



---



# SALARY & GROWTH



**Starting Salary: $700 USD/month**



Your performance will be reviewed after **3 months**, with the opportunity for a salary increase.



Future increases can be based on:



* Creative quality

* Speed

* Reliability

* Initiative

* Skill development

* Creative performance

* Increased responsibility



We are looking for someone who wants to **grow with the company long-term**.



---



# EQUIPMENT



You must have:



* Reliable MacBook or high-performance computer

* Smartphone

* Fast and reliable internet

* Quiet workspace

* Ability to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM



---



# PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF



* You have never created AI videos

* You have never created Meta Ads

* You are only a traditional video editor

* Your experience is mainly YouTube

* You don't understand direct-response advertising

* You cannot produce 20+ creatives per day

* You prefer spending hours on one video

* You are not proactive or organized

* You are not interested in learning new AI tools



---

Please send:



### 1. PORTFOLIO



Send **3–5 examples of your best video ads**.



### 2. EXPERIENCE



How many years have you created video ads for
/Instagram?

### 3. AI TOOLS

What do you use each tool for?



### 4. PRODUCTION

### 5. CREATIVE TEST

* Hook

* What the video would show



### 6. WORKFLOW



How would you produce **20+ creatives per day** while maintaining quality?



### 7. AMBITION



What do you want to achieve professionally in the next 3–5 years?



---



**We are looking for someone who can become a valuable long-term member of our team.**

title: ₱10,000 Referral Fee – Help Us Find a Private Country Home for Rent in Luzon
description:
Hii !



We're searching for a genuinely private and peaceful home to rent long-term in rural Luzon (6 Months to 1+ year), and we're offering a ₱10,000 referral fee to anyone who introduces us to a property we ultimately lease.



We're not looking for luxury. We're looking for privacy, peace, natural surroundings, and a comfortable place to call home.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR...



:)  A standalone house, farmhouse, rest house, or private residential property surrounded by nature.

:)  Genuine privacy is our highest priority. Ideally, no immediate neighbors, nearby houses, or properties above the home.

:)  A generous amount of surrounding land, trees, farmland, or open space.

:)  A comfortable, livable house with electricity, running water, and reliable internet (or ability for us to have StarLink).

:)  Accessible by an ordinary vehicle throughout the year.

:)  Suitable for long-term rental rather than short-term vacation stays.

:)  Pet-friendly (two indoor cats).



LOCATION...



We're looking for rural properties in Luzon, within a maximum of approximately 4 hours' driving distance from Metro Manila in any direction. We're particularly interested in peaceful agricultural communities, mountain foothills, and countryside locations with plenty of open space and privacy.



We're flexible about the province, but the 4-hour-ish driving limit is important because we need reasonable access to Metro Manila, including the airport and government services.



WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR...



:(  Subdivisions, gated communities, or densely populated neighborhoods.

:(  Homes with immediate neighbors or shared residential compounds.

:(  Properties along busy roads or surrounded by commercial activity.

:(  Vacation resorts that aren't available for long-term rental.

:(  Homes that appear private in photographs but are actually surrounded by other houses.



HOW THE REFERRAL FEE WORKS...



If you introduce us to a suitable property and we ultimately sign a rental agreement, we'll pay you ₱10,000 upon signing the lease! You don't need to be a real estate agent. Perhaps a relative owns an unused farmhouse, a neighbor has a vacant countryside property, or you simply know someone who might be willing to rent their home.



We're particularly interested in privately owned properties that may not be advertised online.



This is not an hourly position or a request for online property research. It's a referral opportunity with a one-time payment for a successful introduction.



INTERESTED? LET'S TALK!



If you know of a property that might be a good fit, we'd love to hear from you! You don't need to have everything ready when you first contact us. A simple introduction about a potential property is perfectly fine.



However, anyone pursuing the ₱10,000 referral fee will be responsible for contacting the property owner, confirming their willingness to rent long-term, and gathering the information we need to evaluate the property. This includes photos of the house and surrounding area, the proposed rental price, and a Google Maps location pin so we can examine the property and its surroundings using satellite imagery.



Privacy is extremely important to us, so being able to verify the property's location and proximity to neighboring houses is essential before arranging a viewing. We're happy to discuss promising leads, but we're looking for someone who can help facilitate the introduction and communication with the owner, not simply provide a name or address.



We're actively searching and will be traveling to view properties this weekend, so promising leads may have an opportunity for a viewing on short notice!



Thanks so much!!

title: Controller, Franchise Clients ($4,500/mo + 13th Month + PTO)
description:
Most controller titles offered from the Philippines are a bookkeeping queue with a better name. This one is the real seat. You will be the financial authority for business groups with up to $30 million in revenue, and you will still do your own bank recs.



Who we are



We are a US accounting and tax firm. We have worked with business owners since 1991, and most of our accounting work is for multi-unit franchise groups: owners with ten, twenty or more stores, each in its own entity, closing on the franchise system's period calendar.



You would work directly with us. No agency in the middle, no account manager speaking for you, and nobody billing your hours to a client you are never allowed to talk to.



The seat



You are the controller for a group of our largest franchise clients. When an owner asks whether they can afford the next store, or what the bank will see in the covenant test, you are the person who knows. Not because you read a summary someone else prepared. Because you built the numbers.



What you own:



The close and the financial statements. Every period, on the franchise system's calendar, which for most of our clients means a 13-period year. Statements the owner can use, ready when promised.

Budgets and cash forecasts. You tell the owner what the next quarter looks like before it arrives.

Lender and covenant reporting. You run the covenant calculations and you know where each group stands against its loan terms before the bank does.

Internal controls. Over cash and payables, store by store. You find the gap before it becomes a loss.

Store purchases and sales. You read the closing documents, book the purchase price allocation, set up or retire the assets and intangibles, and produce the numbers a buyer or a lender will ask for.

The owner relationship. You are the owner's main financial contact. You explain the numbers on a call, plainly, and you send weekly reports to the clients who get them. Every week, without a reminder.



You still do the work



This is not an advisory role and it is not a management role. The person in this seat does bank reconciliations.

You reconcile the accounts yourself. Groups with dozens of bank accounts across dozens of entities. You find every difference and you prove it. You do not plug it, and you do not book a balancing entry to make it go away.

You book the hard entries yourself. Franchise fees and the intangibles they create, their amortization, and activity between related entities.

You review newer staff within 48 hours and send their work back with notes they can learn from.

You train. When a newer accountant asks how a client works, you show them that day.

You write it down. Every client you run has a current written procedure: how its bank feeds work and which entries are unusual to it.



If a controller title means you stopped touching reconciliations years ago, this is the wrong seat. We want someone who can explain a covenant test to an owner at ten in the morning and find a $312 difference in a bank rec at eleven.



The grunt work is going away. You help us retire it



We are rolling out AI tools over the coming months, and bank reconciliation matching is first on the list. The aim is to take the repetitive work off your desk so your hours go to the judgment calls.



You will help us test these tools on real clients. That means using them, telling us where they get things wrong, and checking every number they produce until we trust them. You do not need prior experience with AI. You need to want it, and you need to stay skeptical of it.



Hours



You work Philippine hours with a fixed overlap into the US Eastern morning, 7 to 11am Eastern. Owners call in that window and our team meets in it. We agree the rest of your day with you and then we keep to it.



Pay and Benefits



$4,500 USD per month

Plus 13th month pay. Uncommon in a contractor arrangement. We pay it anyway

Unlimited paid time off. The statutory floor in this country is five days a year. We do not count yours at all, and we expect you to spend it

Philippine daytime hours with one agreed US overlap window

Philippine public holidays observed. You work your country's calendar, not ours

Signing bonus to cover a second monitor, UPS, or generator

US CPA or EA sponsorship if you want it. We pay the fees and give you study time

That is the top of what this market pays a controller on US accounts, and we set it there on purpose. We want the best person available, and we do not want to lose them the moment somebody else makes an offer.



What you bring



At least eight years of accounting for US clients, with at least three of them owning the full close and financial reporting for a multi-entity group, as controller or in practice

Franchise or other multi-unit experience: many entities under one owner, with numbers that have to tie

Hands-on experience with store or business acquisitions and sales: closing documents, purchase price allocation, intangibles and amortization

Budgets, cash forecasts and loan covenant reporting you have built yourself

Bank reconciliations you have done yourself in the last twelve months

Experience reviewing other accountants' work and training newer staff

Thomson Reuters Accounting CS. If your command is in another professional package, say which and we will talk. QuickBooks Online and ShareFile are useful

A record of logging your time on every task, because some of our clients are billed on it

English strong enough to explain a set of financial statements to a US business owner on a live call

A stable home setup and the discipline to run your own day

A Philippine CPA or progress toward a US CPA is a plus. It is not required.



How we work



Read this part twice. We hire for it with the same weight as the technical skills above.

No task is beneath the seat. The controller does reconciliations. The title does not change that.

We change how we work, often. We are rebuilding the firm around automation, and processes that worked last year get replaced. When a new process arrives, you try it in good faith. If you think it is wrong, you say so in writing to the person who owns it, with your reasons, and then you follow the decision.

Your knowledge belongs on paper. Being the only person who knows how a client works is not job security here. It is a risk to the client, and we treat it as one.

Disagree with the work, never with the person. Problems go to the right person, privately, in a normal tone. We do not settle disagreements in the team chat.

You own your deadlines. If one is going to slip, you tell us before it slips, not after.

Verify, do not guess. A number you cannot support is not finished, however close the deadline is.



Your first 90 days



Days 1 to 30: You learn our systems and shadow the accountant who runs each client today through one full period close. By day 30 you have run one close yourself with review, bank recs included.

Days 31 to 60: You run your clients' closes and reconciliations yourself, weekly reports included. Every client you hold has a written procedure, written or updated by you. You have had a first financial review call with each owner.

Days 61 to 90: Each of your groups has a cash forecast and, where it has a loan, a covenant calculation you built. You are reviewing newer staff within 48 hours. You have tested our first AI reconciliation tool on at least one of your clients and told us what it gets wrong.

title: Meta & Google Media Buyer

About the Role



We are looking for an experienced **Performance Media Buyer** to manage and optimize paid advertising across **Meta and Google** for a portfolio of growing consumer brands.



This is a hands-on role. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of campaigns, monitoring performance, testing new strategies and creative, managing budgets, and identifying opportunities to improve ROAS and overall profitability.



We are looking for someone who is highly analytical, organized, proactive, and comfortable managing meaningful advertising budgets.



### Responsibilities

- Build, launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns daily

- Optimize toward **ROAS, CAC, CPA, conversion rate, and profitability**

- Scale successful campaigns while maintaining efficiency

- Work with our creative team to identify winning ads and new creative opportunities

- Develop and execute structured creative testing

- Prepare clear weekly reporting on performance, learnings, and next steps

- Identify trends and opportunities within advertising data

### What We're Looking For



- **3+ years of hands-on media buying experience**

- Strong experience with both **Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads**

- Experience working with **e-commerce / consumer product brands**

- Demonstrated experience managing and scaling significant advertising budgets

- Strong understanding of **ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, CPM, CVR, AOV, MER, and LTV**

- Experience with **Shopify** and e-commerce attribution

- Strong understanding of creative testing and how creative impacts paid media performance

- Comfortable analyzing large amounts of performance data

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills

- Excellent attention to detail

- Amazon advertising

- TikTok Ads

- GA4

- Google Merchant Center

- Shopify Plus

- Klaviyo

- Looker Studio / Power BI

We want someone who is constantly asking:

You should be able to look at an advertising account, understand what is driving performance, identify problems, and develop a clear plan for improving results.



The right person will eventually become a trusted owner of paid media across multiple brands and work closely with our internal marketing and creative teams.

title: SEO Strategist – Healthcare Digital Marketing Agency
description:
No More Graveyard Shifts — Work in PH Time Zone



Sustainable Growth Experts (SGE) is a Singapore-based healthcare digital marketing agency helping doctors, specialists, and clinics generate more qualified patient enquiries through performance-driven marketing.



We’re looking for a high-level SEO Strategist who can think beyond rankings, keywords, and checklists.



This is not a senior SEO execution role.



We need someone who can independently analyze a website and its competitive landscape, identify what is actually holding it back, develop a clear SEO strategy, and translate that strategy into actionable priorities for SEO specialists, content teams, link builders, and project managers.



You should be comfortable making strategic decisions without relying heavily on AI or third-party tools to do the thinking for you.



What You'll Own:



SEO Strategy & Diagnosis



- Develop SEO strategies for competitive healthcare and local search markets

- Analyze websites, SERPs, competitors, search intent, content, authority, and site architecture to identify growth opportunities

- Diagnose why a site is not ranking or converting and determine what needs to change

- Prioritize SEO initiatives based on expected impact rather than simply following standard SEO checklists

- Develop clear hypotheses, test them, and adjust strategy based on results



Team & Execution Leadership



- Lead and provide strategic direction to SEO specialists, link builders, and content teams

- Translate high-level SEO strategy into clear tasks, priorities, and deliverables

- Review work and challenge recommendations when the underlying strategy is weak

- Build and improve SEO SOPs, systems, and workflows

- Work closely with Project Managers and other team members to break strategies into actionable campaigns



Organic Growth & Patient Acquisition



- Develop strategies that improve both organic visibility and qualified patient enquiries

- Oversee content strategies across service pages, location pages, blogs, and other conversion-focused assets

- Identify UX, messaging, technical, and content issues that may be limiting conversions

- Develop authority-building and link acquisition strategies appropriate for competitive healthcare markets

- Monitor performance and continuously identify opportunities for improvement



What We're Looking For



We're looking for strategic depth, not just years of experience.



You should have:



- 7+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably with competitive local or healthcare SEO

- Proven experience developing and executing SEO strategies that produced meaningful ranking and organic growth

- Experience leading SEO specialists, content teams, link builders, or external vendors

- Strong understanding of technical SEO, site architecture, topical authority, search intent, local SEO, and content strategy

- Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

- The ability to independently analyze SERPs and websites and explain why you would take a particular approach

- Experience handling difficult SEO problems, competitive markets, algorithm changes, or underperforming websites

- Strong communication skills and the ability to turn strategy into clear direction for an execution team

- Working knowledge of tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and similar platforms



More Important Than the Tools



- We care more about how you think than how many SEO tools you know.

- A strong candidate should be able to look at a website and its SERPs and answer questions such as:

- What is preventing this site from ranking?

- What are competitors doing that this site is not?

- Which SEO opportunities should we prioritize first, and why?

- What would you change in the site's structure, content, authority, or targeting?

- How would you measure whether your strategy is actually working?

- What would you do if the initial strategy did not produce the expected results?



You should be able to explain your reasoning clearly and arrive at your own conclusions—not simply repeat recommendations from SEO tools or AI.



This Role Is a Good Fit If You...



- Enjoy solving difficult SEO problems rather than simply executing SEO tasks

- Naturally question assumptions and look for the root cause

- Can work independently and make decisions with incomplete information

- Are comfortable challenging existing strategies when the data or SERPs suggest a better approach

- Enjoy working closely with specialists, content teams, and project managers

- Want ownership over strategy and outcomes, not just a list of assigned tasks

- Can commit to a full-time agency role and be consistently available to collaborate with the team



This Role Is NOT a Good Fit If You...

- Primarily follow SEO checklists or SOPs without understanding the underlying strategy

- Rely heavily on AI or SEO tools to determine what the strategy should be

- Are strongest at execution but have limited experience independently developing strategy

- Prefer working independently with minimal collaboration or management responsibility



What We Offer

- Starts at PHP 150,000 monthly, depending on experience and demonstrated strategic capability

- Full-time, Monday–Friday

- PH Time Zone — no graveyard shift

- Long-term opportunity with a growing international healthcare marketing agency

- High level of ownership and influence over SEO strategy

- Work directly with experienced leadership and a multidisciplinary marketing team



How to Apply



Please send the following to 

- Your updated CV

- Portfolio, case studies, or examples of SEO campaigns you have personally led

- A short cover letter explaining:

The most difficult SEO problem you have personally solved

What you did to diagnose the problem

The strategy you implemented

The measurable result



Subject line: SEO Strategist – [Your Name]



Important: We are specifically looking for someone who can demonstrate strategic SEO thinking and independent judgment, not simply strong SEO execution.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor + Thumbnails & Uploads | Part-Time
description:
I'm Nunu, the creator behind Nunu Creator Club. I create videos, courses, and tutorials about stationery, creative products, and running a creative business. I'm looking for a reliable, organized video editor who can learn my existing editing and thumbnail style and help me publish consistently.



Please review my YouTube channel before applying:





THE ROLE

Part-time, remote, with flexible working hours. You can work at the times that suit you, provided you communicate clearly and meet our agreed weekly deadlines.



The regular workload is 3 long-form YouTube video packages per week. Each package includes:

- Editing supplied footage into an engaging, polished video that matches my style.

- Creating a YouTube thumbnail that matches my existing branding and visual style.

- Uploading the approved video and thumbnail to YouTube and scheduling publication using our shared content plan.



All 3 videos must be completed, reviewed, and scheduled each week for the following week. We will agree on a weekly handoff deadline that leaves time for feedback and revisions.



This role also requires the ability to edit educational course lessons and step-by-step tutorials in my style. Course/tutorial assignments and their scope will be agreed in advance; they are not an unlimited extra workload on top of the 3 weekly videos.



PAY

US$90 per week for 3 completed video packages (US$30 per package, including editing, thumbnail, and upload/scheduling). This is a deliverable-based, part-time role with flexible hours. Video length, footage volume, editing complexity, and revision expectations will be discussed before we begin so the workload is clear.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit efficiently in CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro.

- Improve pacing, remove mistakes and unnecessary pauses, clean up audio, and add relevant text, close-ups, B-roll, music, or simple graphics where they help the viewer.

- Keep tutorials easy to follow and preserve important teaching steps while making the videos engaging.

- Match my tone, editing choices, fonts, colors, and thumbnail style using my existing content and feedback.

- Upload approved videos, add agreed titles/descriptions and thumbnails, and double-check scheduling details in YouTube Studio.

- Use our shared Google Drive planning document to track topics, footage links, deadlines, feedback, and publication status.

- Keep footage, project files, thumbnails, and final exports clearly named and organized in Google Drive.

- Flag missing assets or potential delays early and apply feedback carefully.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos; experience with courses or tutorials is a plus.

- Strong CapCut OR Adobe Premiere Pro skills; you do not need both.

- Excellent spoken and written English, including the ability to understand spoken instructions and proofread on-screen text.

- A good eye for engaging thumbnails and the ability to adapt to an established creator's style.

- Confidence using YouTube Studio and Google Drive.

- Strong organization, attention to detail, reliable communication, and consistent deadline management.

- A reliable computer and internet connection for handling video files.



This is a LONG-FORM role, not a Shorts, Reels, or TikTok editing position. Please send relevant long-form work rather than a short-form-only portfolio.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Links to 2-3 long-form YouTube videos you personally edited, with a short explanation of your work on each.

2. Examples of YouTube thumbnails you created.

3. Which editing software you use and your experience uploading/scheduling in YouTube Studio.

4. After reviewing my channel, a brief explanation of how you would match my editing and thumbnail style while keeping the videos engaging.

5. Your usual turnaround time, availability to complete 3 video packages weekly, and earliest start date.

6. Confirmation that you understand the budget is US$90 per week for 3 complete packages (US$30 each).



Please begin your application with "Nunu Long-Form Editor" so I can easily identify applications for this role. I look forward to seeing your work!
